chapter: Serenading and playing with Buddy Bolden
title: Starting at nine, 'Kid Galvin' and subbing for other bassists
summary: He began bass at nine, played with Bolden at fifteen to seventeen as 'Kid Galvin', and pinch-hit for Dandy Lewis and the bassist with Manuel Perez.
